annotations.title: Housing demand vs supply and forecasts (finwire)

description: Use for housing demand against supply, the completions forecast and the rent forecast. finwire housing balance for Poland and 17 cities: finwire_housing_pressure (new residents per 1 dwelling completed in the same year, from GUS migration for permanent residence and foreigners insured in ZUS, yearly), finwire_housing_pipeline (forecast of dwellings completed in 4 quarters up to 2 years ahead from GUNB building permits, 80% interval and backtest accuracy per horizon) and finwire_rent_forecast (6-month change of asking rent per m2, published only after passing the accuracy threshold). Present forecasts as model estimates with the interval and accuracy, never as certainty.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") one of 17 cities; omit for Poland and all cities.
